sample_label: Sample data — not live market readings

families.name: Listings
families.description: A new exchange listing, or a credible listing notice, often brings a short burst of attention.

families.name: ETF flows
families.description: Spot ETF creations and redemptions show whether funds were adding or removing coins that day.

families.name: X buzz
families.description: Mentions on X are far above this coin's recent pace. Attention can fade as fast as it arrives.

families.name: Momentum
families.description: Price is moving faster than this coin's own recent habit. Speed is not a direction you can bank on.

families.name: Sentiment
families.description: A broad mood reading such as the Fear & Greed index. It describes the room, not a single coin's future.

families.name: Funding
families.description: Perpetual funding is unusually high or low, which means leveraged traders are crowded to one side.

families.name: Order book
families.description: Bids and asks near the price are lopsided. Books change quickly and can be pulled.

families.name: Divergence
families.description: One exchange's price has pulled away from the others. The gap can close, widen, or be a bad print.
